title: Escaping Low-Dimensional Overlap: Multi-Task Model Merging via High-Dimensional Sparse Disentanglement
abstract: arXiv:2608.25354v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model merging provides an efficient way to construct multi-task generalist models without additional training, but its performance often degrades under severe task interference. Task interference in model merging primarily stems from \textit{superposition}, where task-specific features become entangled within the parameter space. This entanglement renders conventional decomposition methods insufficient for effectively isolating useful task directions from interfering components. In this paper, we propose a sparse-representation-based merging framework that uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to project task vectors into a high-dimensional sparse feature space, enabling feature-level disentanglement before fusion. To reduce computational overhead, we further introduce a lightweight Group-Ranked Zeroth-Order Optimizer (GR-ZOO) to identify task-critical layers for selective merging. translated_title: 逃离低维重叠：通过高维稀疏解缠实现多任务模型合并
translated_abstract: 模型合并提供了一种无需额外训练即可构建多任务通才模型的高效方法，但其性能在严重任务干扰下往往会下降。模型合并中的任务干扰主要源于“叠加”现象，即任务特定特征在参数空间内纠缠在一起。这种纠缠使得传统的分解方法无法有效地区分有用的任务方向与干扰成分。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于稀疏表示的合并框架，该框架使用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将任务向量投影到高维稀疏特征空间，从而在融合前实现特征级解缠。为了减少计算开销，我们进一步引入了一种轻量级的组排名零阶优化器（GR-ZOO），用于识别任务关键层以进行选择性合并。在Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen2.5-7B上的实验表明，该方法的性能优于现有方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于稀疏自编码器和轻量级优化器的高维稀疏解缠框架，用于在多任务模型合并中有效分离任务特定特征，显著提升合并后模型的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a high-dimensional sparse disentanglement framework based on sparse autoencoders and a lightweight optimizer for multi-task model merging, effectively separating task-specific features and significantly improving merged model performance.
